method: For each non-discrete Tersoff numeric column except m, all nonzero entries in that column were scaled together by +/-1%; zero entries stayed zero. This preserves within-column equality groups, signs, and generic positive domains; no least-squares fit or parameter selection was performed.
limitations: The 2019 publication and author-specific cross-column constraints were not available in the archive, so this is a diagnostic column-direction screen, not a constraint-certified fit parameterization.
Five 48-atom snapshots share one crystallographic parent; their k mesh is fixed at 10x10x4. They are correlated response samples, not independent validation families.
The 114-atom TSC-only slab is one frozen structure derived by deleting Ag from the optimized 135-atom interface; it is not an independently relaxed clean surface.
No Si displacement response exists in the audited DFT set.
